app.name: Emdash
app.one_liner: Emdash is an open-source Agentic Development Environment that enables parallel execution of multiple coding agents in isolated git worktrees, locally or over SSH.

screens.name: Main Workspace
screens.purpose: Primary interface for managing tasks, agent conversations, file navigation, and PR/diff reviews.
primary_actions: Create new task from issue tracker
Run coding agent on selected task

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure SSH connections, provider credentials, terminal preferences, and application behavior.
primary_actions: Manage SSH keys and ProxyJump settings

rust_commands.name: list_items
rust_commands.purpose: Retrieve list of tasks, agents, or files for display in UI.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Persist user input or agent-generated content to disk or database.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build main screen layout with sidebar and editor pane
week 1: Implement core task-agent binding logic
week 1: Integrate basic SSH/SFTP connection handler
week 1: Set up isolated git worktree management
acceptance_tests: Application remains responsive during heavy file system activity without deep-observing entire tree on every fs-watch event.
Tasks created from GitHub/Linear/Jira appear in collapsible sidebar under their respective providers.
Text input fields consistently accept keyboard input across all screens and modal states.
User can successfully run a coding agent on a remote SSH project using OS keychain-stored credentials.
